data.raw_text:
'WELGA KAMI!' 

TINGNAN: Nagtipon ang iba’t ibang organisasyon sa isang malawakang transport strike ngayong araw upang ipanawagan ang pagbasura sa Oil Deregulation Law. 

Isinagawa ang nasabing kilos-protesta sa tapat ng West Point corner Aurora Boulevard sa Cubao, Quezon City, bilang bahagi ng militanteng pakikibaka laban sa walang humpay na pagtaas ng presyo ng langis.

data.english_translation: 'WEL WEAH!' LOOK: Various organizations have gathered on a large transport stretch today to call for disposal of the Oil Deliverance Law. This time a protest has been carried out opposite West Point corner Aurora Boulevard in Cubao, Quezon City, as part of a militant battle against the relentless increase in oil prices.
